connector.name: SOAPNoteAPI
connector.registryDescription: Generate clinical SOAP notes, billing codes, and visit summaries from transcripts or audio.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package soapnoteapi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.soapnoteapi, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SOAPNOTEAPI_KEY
env.description: SOAPNoteAPI Bearer key (snapi_sk_...). Get one at https://app.soapnoteapi.com
